responsibility: Defines the enumeration and query interface for built-in Modula-2 language exceptions in gm2. It names the standard runtime exception categories such as index, range, division, pointer, coroutine, and exception-state errors, and declares predicates/accessors used by handlers to determine whether the current exceptional execution arose from a language exception and which one it was.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface file for M2EXCEPTION: it declares the M2Exceptions enumeration and the public query procedures, while M2EXCEPTION.mod contains the runtime checks against RTExceptions that make those queries work.
